title: dashboard-config.yaml
description: Site settings of the calibration dashboard (file version 1). Generated from src/config/schema.ts.

version.description: File version; a newer one than the app reads is reported.

pages.description: Page files in display order; the first is the landing page.

title.description: Dashboard title: the header text and the browser tab title.

light.description: Full logo shown when the navigation is expanded (light theme).

dark.description: Full logo for the dark theme.

light.description: Abbreviated logo shown when the navigation is collapsed (light theme).

dark.description: Abbreviated logo for the dark theme.

primary.description: Primary data colour (transit and the chart palette).

brand.description: Interface colour: selected pills, titles, tags and focus rings.

modes.description: Travel modes: label, raw data ids and a mode colour token.

purposes.description: Trip purposes: label and raw data ids.

incomes.description: Income groups: label and raw data ids.

autos.description: Auto-ownership groups: label and raw data ids.

districts.description: District names for flow charts and the VMT hierarchy.

metrics.description: Per-metric label, unit, decimals, scale and hidden overrides.

divisor.description: Divisor for trip counts in the time-of-day charts.

suffix.description: Suffix shown after a divided trip count.

transit_share_max.description: Top of the transit-share map ramp.

list.description: Model years in display order: a year, or { year, label }.

default.description: Whether Compare starts on: auto turns it on with two or more independent scenarios.

scenarios.description: Scenario groups compared at first load (default: every loaded one).

reference.description: The reference: a scenario group id or `observed`.

mode.description: How pages are shown unless a page or the viewer says otherwise.

footer.description: Line under exported images: true (source, scenarios, year, date), false (none) or your own text.

enabled.description: Turns the AI assistant (button, panel and Settings tab) on or off.

providers.description: The AI providers the assistant tab offers, replacing the built-in ones: id, label, base_url, models, needs_key, protocol (openai or anthropic). The address of a listed provider is fixed.

provider.description: The provider the assistant tab starts on (an id from the offered providers).

model.description: The model the assistant tab starts with (any model name).

prompt_addendum.description: A short plain-text note added after the assistant’s instructions (for example: Our zones are called TAZs). At most 2000 characters; the viewer does not see it.

round_trips.description: Steps the assistant may take to answer one question: 1 to 12 (default 6).

preview_rows.description: Rows of a query result shown to the viewer: 100 to 5000 (default 1000).

model_rows.description: Rows of a result shared with the model when the viewer shares results: 1 to 200 (default 50).

url.description: Address of the documentation site; sets a link at the foot of the left sidebar (none when unset).

label.description: Text of the documentation link (default: Documentation).

tabs.description: Settings window tabs, in order: appearance, scenarios, basemap, assistant, documentation (default: all five).

default.description: Default basemap id (a tab or panel may choose its own).

pmtiles_url.description: A self-hosted PMTiles file for the Protomaps basemaps.

api_key.description: A hosted Protomaps key restricted to the site domain (never a secret token).

csv_rows.description: Explore builder limit. Rows a CSV export may hold. 1 to 5,000,000 (default 100,000). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

page_size.description: Explore builder limit. Rows per page in the Data tab (unset: as many as the tile is tall). 5 to 200. A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

undo_steps.description: Explore builder limit. How many changes can be undone. 1 to 500 (default 60). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

max_joins.description: Explore builder limit. Joins the query builder allows. 1 to 8 (default 4). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

chart_rows.description: Explore builder limit. Groups a chart may draw before it says it is cut. 100 to 1,000,000 (default 50,000). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

scatter_sample.description: Explore builder limit. Points a scatter plot samples. 100 to 100,000 (default 5,000). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

histogram_bins.description: Explore builder limit. Bins of the histogram chart. 2 to 100 (default 12). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

legend_series.description: Explore builder limit. Legend values drawn before the rest are cut. 2 to 50 (default 15). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

distinct_values.description: Explore builder limit. Values a filter list offers. 10 to 5,000 (default 200). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

pivot_rows.description: Explore builder limit. Rows a pivot table draws. 20 to 5,000 (default 500). A panel or page may set its own; the lower level wins per key.

features.description: Explore builder features switched on or off; maps merge per key.

allow.description: Chart types the builder offers; a lower level replaces the list.

include.description: Table name globs the builder may use; a lower level replaces the list.

exclude.description: Table name globs the builder hides; lower levels add to the list.

columns.description: Column label, unit and format overrides; maps merge per key.

presets.description: Starter charts; lower levels add to the list.
